newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish paintmaker Polifarb Debica IPO cleared.
newsitem.headline: Polish paintmaker Polifarb Debica IPO cleared.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission cleared 1,335,000 existing shares and a new issue of 700,000 shares of Polish paint maker Polifarb Debica, the commission's chairman Jacek Socha told a news conference on Thursday.

Polifarb Debica, which seeks the main market's listing, would offer the shares in three tranches: 350,000 shares for institutional investors, 150,000 shares in the retail tranche and 200,000 for current shareholders.
The subscription is scheduled for February 17-18 for institutions and for February 17-21 in the retail and shareholder tranches.
Polifarb Debica's main shareholders are National Investment Fund No 11, which has a 33-percent stake in the firm and the state treasury which holds 25 percent of shares.

The company had a net profit of 8.1 million zlotys on 117.5 million-zloty-sales last year. In the January-September period of 1996 it showed a net profit of 10.2 million zlotys on 111.3-million-zloty-sales.
It expected its net profit to rise to 17 million zlotys in 1997 and sales to 148.1 million zlotys next year.
